asked QB2-014: The freeze writes scheme_final.jsonl. The working scheme marks its tiers 'main' (183) and 'rare' (14). The B2 close-check (checks/stage_B2.py) accepts only tier None, rare, common or core on scheme_final.jsonl, so 'main' fails it 183 times. The C1 check (checks/stage_C1.py) expects scheme_final.jsonl and scheme_v2.jsonl to use main|rare, and finds moves to rare by ftier == 'main'. With 'common' the B2 check passes, but C1 would never see a move from main to rare. Which word do you want in the frozen file, and will the handler make the two checks agree? | meanwhile: scheme_final.jsonl writes 'common' for the 183 main themes and 'rare' for the 14 rare ones, and scheme_final.md says so. If you want 'main', I supersede scheme_final.jsonl under a new name once the B2 check accepts it.
